description: ENERGY STAR Portfolio Manager is the EPA's free, secure online tool for benchmarking the energy use of any type of building, turning utility bill information into comparisons with a building's past use, national medians, similar buildings in a portfolio or a reference level. The EPA says nearly 25% of U.S. commercial building space is actively benchmarked in Portfolio Manager, which is also Canada's national benchmarking tool. Many building types can receive a 1 to 100 ENERGY STAR score that compares energy performance with similar buildings nationwide, normalised for weather and operating characteristics, where 50 is the median; users need only their bills and basic building information. Coverage: buildings in the United States and Canada. Access: free account on the web. Licence: U.S. government tool. Caveats: results depend on self-reported data, and only some building types can receive a score. Simulation uses are benchmark metrics and scores for building stock analysis and city benchmarking programmes. Related records: the NYC Local Law 84 and Seattle benchmarking datasets built from Portfolio Manager submissions.
